verify.template:
Run the full Python verification suite at repo root:
1. ruff check .
2. ruff format --check .
3. ty check
4. uv run pytest -q

For subprojects, run the same suite inside the project directory (GUI tests need QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen). Show any failures and suggest fixes.
verify.description: Python 四项验收（ruff → ty → pytest）

test.template:
Run pytest for the relevant test directory. Use -q for quiet, -x to stop on first failure.
If no directory specified, run `uv run pytest -q` at repo root or inside the subproject directory.
